- Thu Oct 15, 10:00–11:15 AM PT

Draft agenda (attached):
1) Introductions & success criteria (10m)
2) Implementation scope and timeline (15m)
3) Integration requirements: network/SSO/data flows (20m)
4) Roles, owners, and next steps (10–15m)

I attached a short kickoff-agenda-draft.pdf and will follow up with a calendar invite once we agree on time.

Thanks — looking forward to this.
